title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in the development of the fetus and the health of the mother. A balanced and varied diet will provide the necessary nutrients for both mother and baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping to build balanced and delicious meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnant Women
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, helping to support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, helping to support the development of bones and teeth in the fetus.
- Lentils: rich in iron, helping to support blood production and reduce the risk of anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, helping to support the development of the brain and eyes in the fetus.
- Eggs: rich in protein, helping to support the development of muscles and tissues in the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, helping to support the immune system and reduce the risk of disease.

## Combining International Pantry Staples into Meals
To combine these international pantry staples into meals, you can try the following:
- Add oats to breakfast, combined with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Use lentils in stews and soups.
- Grill low-mercury salmon and serve with leafy greens and citrus.
- Add eggs to breakfast, combined with leafy greens and whole grains.

## Food Safety Considerations
When preparing and consuming food, especially during pregnancy, it is essential to consider food safety. Ensure that:
- Food is cooked thoroughly before consumption.
- Avoid consuming raw or undercooked food, especially meat, eggs, and seafood.
- Wash hands thoroughly before and after handling food.
- Keep food at a safe temperature to avoid bacterial contamination.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples that are good for pregnant women can help build balanced and delicious meals. Remember to combine these staples into meals and consider food safety to ensure the health of both mother and baby. To learn more about pregnancy nutrition and delicious recipes, you can visit our [meal planner](/planner) or join our [prenatal nutrition program](/premium) to receive support and guidance from nutrition experts.
